comment: The campaign spine: ACCEPTANCE-PROTOCOL.md 0.2 steps 1-8 compiled to data. Execution order = file order. Every gate/probe/judgement names the defect it catches and the scenario where protocol/selftest.sh sees it fail (load is refused otherwise - owner rule 2026-09-01: decisive and falsifiable over probable).

steps.title: Download the CI artifacts for the pinned release

on_fail.msg: artifact download failed 3x - fix gh/network, then start a new campaign

steps.title: Gate 0: the payload is built from the pinned commit, not HEAD

on_fail.msg: The payload does not match the pinned commit. Rebuild the artifacts or fix REL. NEVER re-gate against HEAD - it moves under a campaign. Every cell run on an ungated payload is INVALID-PROVENANCE.

steps.defect: 2026-08-29 f777bec: a whole cell ran against the commit BEFORE the fix under test, because the payload was never asserted against the pinned release

steps.title: Entry-image custody: win10-base matches its seal (never booted to check)

on_fail.msg: Do NOT clone from win10-base. Rebuild the golden (runbook 0.6c) or re-seal deliberately with the change recorded. Every cell derived from an unverified golden is INVALID-CONTAMINATED.

steps.defect: 2026-08-29/30: the Win10 golden served as a scratch guest all evening (binary hot-swapped, xencons side-loaded, Windows Update toggled) and cells were then cloned from it; a booted golden gains a volume revision its seal never recorded

steps.title: Entry-image custody: win11-base matches its seal

on_fail.msg: Do NOT clone from win11-base. Rebuild or re-seal deliberately; see runbook 0.4/0.6c.

steps.defect: same class as win10-base: an unsealed or drifted entry image contaminates every clone silently (V6: the win10 proof does not cover this check - each subject class earns its own)

steps.title: P0 preflight: no template carries a netvm
steps.command: qvm-ls --raw-data --fields NAME,STATE,CLASS,NETVM | awk -F'|' '$3=="TemplateVM" && $4!="" && $4!="-" {print "TEMPLATE-HAS-NETVM:"$1; bad=1} END {if(!bad) print "NETVM-OK"}'

on_fail.msg: A template carries a netvm (NET-0: STOP-and-report). Detach it (qvm-prefs <tpl> netvm ''), then start a new campaign.

steps.defect: networking on a TEMPLATE is prohibited (CLAUDE.md); a template with a netvm poisons every AppVM test deriving from it, and a cell run against a failed precondition is INVALID-PRECONDITION, not a product verdict

steps.title: H3.6: a campaign starts with ZERO Windows guests running
steps.command: qvm-ls --raw-data --fields NAME,STATE | awk -F'|' '/^win1/ && $2!="Halted" {print "RUNNING:"$1; bad=1} END {if(!bad) print "ALL-HALTED"}'

on_fail.msg: Shut down each printed guest: qvm-shutdown --wait --timeout 300 <name>. A guest that flips back to Transient is queued qrexec restarting it - drain per runbook 2.5 (qrexec_timeout 15 -> kill -> Halted CONTINUOUSLY -> restore 6000; 15 is never left in place). Then start a NEW campaign.

steps.defect: concurrent Windows guests have destroyed each other's results; three 8GB guests starved qubesd; per-second qrexec churn triggered the IPI-shootdown wedge

steps.title: The three inputs the matrix actually consumes exist - the ls is load-bearing, not ceremony

on_fail.msg: A harness input is missing. Under the release-only model the matrix consumes the setup TREE (prime-run payload for the clean cells; install.cmd at its root, reference/gui-agent.exe for ASHA) and the release ISO (the CD every over-existing cell installs from) straight from {MATRIX_WORK}/dl. Re-download the artifacts; NEVER substitute a file from another build.

steps.defect: matrix.sh fails closed on a missing reference/gui-agent.exe, but only at its own startup, and a missing ISO aborts only when the first over-existing cell resolves the release loop - after gates have passed and guests may already have churned; a missing input caught here is INVALID before anything boots

steps.title: Re-gate the ISO: the medium the cells will install from names the pinned commit
steps.command: got=$(7z e -so {MATRIX_WORK}/dl/qwt-improved-iso/qwt-improved-setup.iso MANIFEST.json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import json,sys;print((json.load(sys.stdin).get("source") or {}).get("driver_repo_commit") or "")'); want=$(git rev-parse {REL}); if [ -n "$got" ] && [ "${got:0:12}" = "${want:0:12}" ]; then echo "PASS: payload verified - the ISO's embedded MANIFEST names ${got:0:12} ({REL})"; else echo "FAIL: ISO's embedded MANIFEST names '${got:-nothing}', expected ${want:0:12} ({REL})"; exit 1; fi

on_fail.msg: The release ISO does not name the pinned commit. It is a stale or foreign medium - re-download the run's artifacts; never substitute. (matrix.sh re-gates the mounted disc AND each guest re-reads the disc MANIFEST - this is the first leg of that chain, before anything boots.)

steps.defect: a stale ISO left from a previous campaign (or a wrong-run download) silently delivers a different build than Gate 0 verified - the setup tree and the disc are separate artifacts and each must prove its own provenance

steps.title: CELLS and the entry images G10/G11 are explicitly named (no defaults)

on_fail.msg: CELLS, G10 and G11 must each be explicitly set. matrix.sh now refuses an unset CELLS outright, but naming the cells HERE keeps the refusal before any gate spends time - and a mistyped selector still FAILs its cell rather than shrinking the matrix silently. G10/G11 name the OVER-EXISTING entry fixtures (previous-ours, e.g. win10-iqi) for the upgrade/seeded cells; the old default carried the release under test, so 'fresh' cells silently became reinstall cells. The documented selectors are win1X-clean/reinstall/upgrade/seeded/appvm (stock = deliberate capability, grade1X = grade-only).

steps.defect: runbook 0.9.4/0.9.6: a 0-cell run with a normal-looking summary was read as a passed campaign; goldens carrying the candidate made every fresh/upgrade cell a same-version reinstall

steps.title: Run the cells, serially, through the harness (never a hand-rolled runner)
steps.command: CELLS="{CELLS}" G10={G10} G11={G11} RELEASE_COMMIT={REL} MATRIX_WORK={MATRIX_WORK} MATRIX_OUT={MATRIX_OUT} bash mgmt/harness/matrix.sh

on_fail.msg: A cell failed or the matrix aborted. The failing guest's state is EVIDENCE (G-0): do not touch it, do not re-run, do not reboot, do not 'just try one thing'. Read $MATRIX_OUT/matrix.log and the per-cell logs; write the verdict first. Diagnosis happens on a CLONE (or a PARK taken beforehand), never on the failed subject. Restore afterwards with mgmt/harness/checkpoint.sh (undo-session = the failed cell's entry state, seconds) - NEVER a reprovision unless the cell under test is install-at-first-logon itself.

steps.defect: a cell FAILs or the matrix aborts before its footer; on 2026-08-30 a failing campaign was still reported complete because the summary was prose

steps.title: The matrix actually ran cells: '0 passed, 0 failed' is a vacuous run, not a pass

on_fail.msg: The matrix executed ZERO cells (an unset/mistyped CELLS matches no selector; the run prints a normal-looking footer and does nothing). No cell verdict exists. Fix CELLS and run a new campaign; never read this footer as a passed campaign.

steps.defect: runbook 0.9.4: an unset CELLS defaults to the string 'seeded' which matches NO case arm - a 0-cell run with a normal-looking summary was read as a passed campaign on 2026-08-30

steps.title: P1.0 authority rule: each cell's PRECONDITION line matches the identity its label claims

judgement.question: The file lists, for every cell, its label and the '=== PRECONDITION ===' line from its install log. For EVERY cell: does the PRECONDITION line's found-state match what the cell label claims to test (fresh label = no QWT found; upgrade/stock label = the expected prior version found)?

answers.ALL_MATCH: every cell's PRECONDITION line matches its label's claimed identity
answers.MISMATCH: at least one cell's PRECONDITION line contradicts its label
answers.LINE_ABSENT: at least one cell has no PRECONDITION line in its install log

on_fail.msg: The installer's PRECONDITION line is the authority on found state; a cell whose label disagrees with it tested something other than what it claims. Void that cell; a harness probe disagreeing with the line is the harness being wrong.

steps.defect: the c1f4312 voiding: cells called 'fresh'/'upgrade' silently took the same-version-reinstall branch because the entry image already carried the release; only the PRECONDITION line exposed it
